async def act(page):
    """
    Add a simple product named "Lelelumon Yoga Mat" with price $769.99, qty 42, In Stock,
    with custom options: size -> uni-size and color -> black.

    Notes:
    - Use accessibility-centric selectors (page.get_by_role, page.get_by_label, .nth()).
    - Use relative goto for navigating to the Manage Products page.
    - The final action (Save) may navigate away; keep it as the last step.
    """
    import asyncio

    # 0) Small helper wrappers that use accessibility selectors only
    async def try_fill_by_label(label, value, index=0, timeout=2000):
        try:
            locator = page.get_by_label(label).nth(index)
            await locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await locator.fill(value)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_select_combobox(name, option_label):
        try:
            cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name).nth(0)
            await cb.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=2000)
            await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
            return True
        except Exception:
            # try any combobox with the option (no name)
            try:
                cb_any = page.get_by_role("combobox").nth(0)
                await cb_any.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                return False

    async def try_click_role(role, name=None, index=0, timeout=2000):
        try:
            if name:
                el = page.get_by_role(role, name=name).nth(index)
            else:
                el = page.get_by_role(role).nth(index)
            await el.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await el.click()
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    # 1) Go to Manage Products (relative goto). This is a navigation but allowed.
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/catalog_product/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

    # 2) Click the Add Product / Add New Product button
    clicked_add = False
    for name in ("Add Product", "Add New Product", "Add New"):
        if await try_click_role("button", name=name):
            clicked_add = True
            break
        # sometimes it's a link
        if await try_click_role("link", name=name):
            clicked_add = True
            break
    if not clicked_add:
        # try a generic button if above failed
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            clicked_add = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not clicked_add:
        # Could not open product create page; aborting this act.
        return

    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

    # 3) If Attribute Set / Product Type shown, try to accept defaults and continue.
    # Try clicking Continue if present (it may be a button)
    if await try_click_role("button", name="Continue"):
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(1)

    # 4) Fill main product fields
    # Name
    await try_fill_by_label("Name", "Lelelumon Yoga Mat")
    # Price
    await try_fill_by_label("Price", "769.99")
    # SKU: let the system auto-generate if present; skip if not

    # 5) Inventory tab -> set Qty = 42 and Stock Availability = In Stock
    # Open Inventory tab if available
    await try_click_role("tab", name="Inventory")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Fill Qty - try common labels
    await try_fill_by_label("Qty", "42")
    await try_fill_by_label("Quantity", "42")
    # Set Stock Availability
    await try_select_combobox("Stock Availability", "In Stock")
    # also try combobox option without name
    if not await try_select_combobox("Stock Availability", "In Stock"):
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("combobox").first.select_option(label="In Stock")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # 6) Custom Options tab: add Size (uni-size) and Color (black) as drop-down values
    await try_click_role("tab", name="Custom Options")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    # Add Size option
    if await try_click_role("button", name="Add New Option"):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        # Try fill the first option title as "size"
        await try_fill_by_label("Title", "size", index=0)
        # Try set input type to Drop-down
        try:
            # try combobox with label Input Type or Type
            if not await try_select_combobox("Input Type", "Drop-down"):
                await try_select_combobox("Type", "Drop-down")
        except Exception:
            pass
        # Add a new row/value for this option
        await try_click_role("button", name="Add New Row")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        # Fill the first option value title with uni-size
        # Depending on markup there may be multiple "Title" inputs; try index 1
        await try_fill_by_label("Title", "uni-size", index=1)

    # Add Color option
    if await try_click_role("button", name="Add New Option"):
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        # Fill title (next available)
        # Try index 2 as a reasonable guess for the next title
        await try_fill_by_label("Title", "color", index=2)
        # Set type to Drop-down
        try:
            if not await try_select_combobox("Input Type", "Drop-down"):
                await try_select_combobox("Type", "Drop-down")
        except Exception:
            pass
        # Add a row and fill value
        await try_click_role("button", name="Add New Row")
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        # Fill the option value title with black
        # Try index 3 for the value input title
        await try_fill_by_label("Title", "black", index=3)

    # 7) Save the product (this likely navigates away; keep as the last action)
    # Prefer a Save button with explicit name
    saved = False
    for name in ("Save", "Save and Continue Edit", "Save Item"):
        if await try_click_role("button", name=name):
            saved = True
            break
    if not saved:
        # fallback: click the first visible button (conservative)
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            saved = True
        except Exception:
            saved = False

    if saved:
        # wait a bit for save/navigation to complete
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
        await asyncio.sleep(1)

    return

Plan and reasoning:
1) Determine navigation path: the Manage Products admin page can be reached via a relative URL. Using page.goto with a relative path is allowed and reliable; therefore I will navigate to /index.php/admin/catalog_product/.
2) Use accessibility-centric selectors only: per the error in the previous attempt, avoid CSS locators. I will rely exclusively on page.get_by_role and page.get_by_label and their .nth()/.first accessors, plus .select_option for comboboxes.
3) Add Product: try to click common button names ("Add Product", "Add New Product"). Use role-based selectors and fallback to the first button if necessary.
4) Fill product fields: use get_by_label("Name") and get_by_label("Price"). These are the most reliable accessible selectors for form fields.
5) Inventory: open the Inventory tab using get_by_role("tab", name="Inventory") and set Qty by get_by_label("Qty") or "Quantity". Set Stock Availability via get_by_role("combobox", name="Stock Availability").select_option(label="In Stock").
6) Custom Options: open the Custom Options tab and use the "Add New Option" button. All interactions inside custom options are attempted via get_by_role("button", name=...) and get_by_label("Title") for option titles. For input type selection use combobox selection (Input Type or Type). For option values, try clicking "Add New Row" and filling subsequent Title inputs with uni-size and black. Due to variability of markup, indices (.nth()) are used cautiously.
7) Save: click a button named Save (or common variants). This action usually navigates away, so it is the final action.

Knowledge base functions: there are no external knowledge_base functions provided in the environment, so none were used; all logic is implemented directly with Playwright calls.

Selectors used: only accessibility-centric selectors (page.get_by_role, page.get_by_label) and their .nth() or .first access; no CSS locators were used.

If any specific accessibility names differ on the target installation, the script includes multiple fallbacks for common label/button names to maximize success.
